description_target.target_text: Template completion: largest shape is template. Each other color group completes to match template. Merged-color-first, fallback to per-component.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Background is blue(1). The most numerous color draws the complete
 ;; TEMPLATE shape; every other color is a fragment of it. Slide the
 ;; template (kept in bounds) until the fragment sits inside its
 ;; footprint, then fill the footprint's background cells with the
 ;; fragment's color — the whole color at once when possible, else
 ;; each 8-connected piece on its own.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg 1)
     (define present  ;; non-bg colors, first-appearance order
       (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v bg)))
               (remove-duplicates
                (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                     (grid-positions g)))))
     (define (cells-of color) (reverse (find-color g color)))
     (define tmpl-color
       (pick-max present (lambda (c) (length (cells-of c)))))
     (define tmpl-rel
       (let ((cells (cells-of tmpl-color)))
         (map (lambda (c) (list (- (first c) (min-of first cells))
                                (- (second c) (min-of second cells))))
              cells)))
     (define (placement-at cell t cells)
       ;; anchor template offset t on cell; ok if the whole fragment
       ;; lands inside the footprint and the footprint stays in bounds
       (let ((or2 (- (first cell) (first t)))
             (oc (- (second cell) (second t))))
         (and (all? (lambda (c2) (member (list (- (first c2) or2)
                                               (- (second c2) oc))
                                         tmpl-rel))
                    cells)
              (all? (lambda (t2) (in-bounds? (+ or2 (first t2))
                                             (+ oc (second t2)) h w))
                    tmpl-rel)
              (list or2 oc))))
     (define (find-origin cells)
       (find-first (lambda (x) x)
                   (for*/list ((cell cells) (t tmpl-rel))
                     (placement-at cell t cells))))
     (define (fill out origin color)
       (for/fold ((acc out)) ((t tmpl-rel))
         (let ((nr (+ (first origin) (first t)))
               (nc (+ (second origin) (second t))))
           (if (= (at acc nr nc) bg)
               (set-cell acc nr nc color)
               acc))))
     (for/fold ((out g))
               ((color (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c tmpl-color)))
                               present)))
       (let* ((cells (cells-of color))
              (origin (find-origin cells)))
         (if origin
             (fill out origin color)
             (for/fold ((o2 out))
                       ((comp (map obj-cells
                                   (objects-8 (paint-cells
                                               (empty-grid h w 0)
                                               cells 1)
                                              0))))
               (let ((co (find-origin comp)))
                 (if co (fill o2 co color) o2)))))))))
